functions.name: plan-draft
functions.description: Date an existing draft without committing it to auto-publication. Can turn a scheduled draft into an inert plan.

planAt.description: Future timezone-qualified instant or next-free-slot for an inert plan; now is not allowed.

draftId.description: Existing draft to plan or replan.

FunctionInput_typefully_v2_plandraft.description: Identify an existing draft and assign a future inert plan date.

scheduledDate.description: Assigned inert plan instant in UTC, or null/absent if unavailable.

FunctionOutput_typefully_v2_plandraft.description: The updated draft identity, stored lifecycle, and assigned inert plan date.

tags.instructions: Get IDs and current state from `get-draft`. Requires WRITE for plain/planned drafts and PUBLISH when converting a scheduled draft, because that disarms its schedule. A plan never auto-publishes; use `publish-draft` to confirm it later. Use `cancel-draft-schedule` to clear a date completely.

functions.name: publish-draft
functions.description: Submit an existing draft for immediate publication or schedule it for a future instant or the next free slot. Confirms an inert plan into a publishing commitment.

draftId.description: Existing draft to publish or schedule.

publishAt.description: Future timezone-qualified instant, next-free-slot, or now. Defaults to now; never implicitly reuses a plan date.

FunctionInput_typefully_v2_publishdraft.description: Identify an existing draft and choose immediate publication or a future publishing commitment.

id.description: Draft ID whose publication was requested.

status.description: Stored lifecycle; may still be draft during immediate publication.

publishState.description: Async progress; finished is not proof of publication success.

scheduledDate.description: Assigned publishing instant in UTC; null or absent for immediate/undated states.

FunctionOutput_typefully_v2_publishdraft.description: Stored draft lifecycle and asynchronous progress after requesting publication or scheduling.

tags.instructions: Use IDs from `list-drafts` or `create-draft` and inspect content with `get-draft` first. Requires PUBLISH access. Omit publishAt for immediate submission. To confirm a planned draft at its existing date, pass its scheduledDate. Use `plan-draft` for an inert date instead. Submission does not prove delivery: inspect `get-draft` until publishState is finished, then check status and platform URLs.

For publication, inert planning or clearing dates use `publish-draft`, `plan-draft` or `cancel-draft-schedule`. Scheduled drafts need PUBLISH access even for content edits.
